name: Tongariro National Park
description: Tongariro National Park, in the middle of New Zealand's North Island, is the country's oldest national park and centres on three volcanoes: Ruapehu, Ngauruhoe and Tongariro. Hikers cross its craters and alpine terrain on the famous Tongariro Alpine Crossing, and skiers use Ruapehu's slopes. The peaks are sacred to the Māori, which is why the park is listed for both its culture and its nature.
